_help: Copy this file to settings.json and edit that copy; settings.json is git-ignored, so updates never overwrite it. Every key is optional: delete one to use the built-in default, which the monitor names at startup.

cache._persist_to_file_help: Set false to keep news, report, and 4chan baselines only until this process exits.

alerts._building_corrections_help: The one alert that ships off. When your building counts drift from the game the monitor always corrects the sheet; this only decides how it tells you. Left false it prints one line to the terminal and keeps polling. Set true and it raises the usual blocking dialog instead, listing every have and disabled count it changed. Off is the default because a correction is nearly always your own building work reaching the sheet a poll later, and a dialog stops the monitor until you dismiss it. A sheet layout or mapping problem - where cells were NOT written - always pops up regardless of this setting.

sound._wav_path_help: Set wav_path to null to use the normal Windows alert sound.

reports._ignore_help: Each entry below is one thing you can silence. The two-hourly tick is ALWAYS collapsed to one line, '[TICK HAPPENED - check details in game] (Satisfaction N)', followed by any warnings inside that tick; you do not switch that on. The Tick entry below is only an escape hatch: switch it on and a tick that carried NO warnings raises no alert at all. A tick that did carry a warning always alerts. Action: matches the recipe name and silences that completed action as one report, including its spent/paid/gained lines. The remaining entries are advanced per-line patterns for standalone report families. Matching ignores case; % stands for any run of characters. An entry starting with # is switched off: delete the # to switch it on.
ignore: You have created the military force
reports._actions_help: Action selectors use the actual recipe name from the game. 'Action: Build %' covers all 38 building, weapon and armour recipes whose names begin Build. Exact examples show how to silence only Burn Oil or only Distribute Pies. You can use any other name from the Actions page, or a family such as 'Action: Upgrade %', 'Action: Ship %', 'Action: Dig %', 'Action: Plow %', 'Action: Manufacture %', 'Action: Smuggle %' or 'Action: Distribute %'.
reports._tick_help: Tick is one option because cron/frequent.php writes one tick report. What the collapse absorbs: the wrapper, production and consumption, relation and satisfaction effects, caps, government/economy/military upkeep, siphons, empire jealousy, environment repair, and the five standing satisfaction penalties you brought on yourself (disabled buildings, military size, empire size, owning no buildings, pollution). What always alerts instead of collapsing: running out of a good so a building, government, economy or force stops working; a force lost to unpaid upkeep; combat; a revolt; an airstrike; the forbidden research. The tick's satisfaction change is always carried on the marker, because the collapse hides every line that explains it.
reports._trade_help: 'You bought ...' and 'You sold ...' are each written to BOTH sides of a trade, with identical wording, so the monitor cannot tell which side you were. On marketplace.php 'You bought' goes to whoever clicked buy and 'You sold' goes to the seller whose listing was taken; on buyermarketplace.php it is the other way round. So the shipped 'You bought' pattern silences your own purchases AND a stranger filling your standing buy order. No 'You sold' pattern ships, because switching it on would also silence somebody buying from your standing sell order, which is usually the news you wanted. Add one yourself if you trade often enough that you would rather not hear about it.
reports._omissions_help: Two routine-looking families deliberately have NO pattern. 'You received % %.' is left out because the deal you accepted and a deal somebody else accepted read alike apart from the words 'as part of your deal', so any pattern short enough to cover the first covers the second, and the second is somebody acting on you. The eighteen Major Action lines ('Government changed to %', 'Economy changed to %', 'Nation name changed from % to %') are left out because you take one perhaps twice a year and seeing it confirmed is the point. ('You lose % sat for having an empire of % nations.' was a third until 2026-08-25, on the grounds that it was a standing penalty worth watching. It is now treated as routine: you know you built the empire, and it fires every single tick, which stopped the tick ever collapsing.)

market._goods_help: A good whose key starts with # is switched off: delete the # to watch that good's buyer's market, and the monitor will alert every poll while a matching order is pending and you have stock spare above both your own Used amount and that good's reserve.
market._reserve_help: Every mode first takes your own Used amount off your Qty - one tick of your consumption has to stay on hand whatever the mode says - and measures what is left, which the help below calls the spare. No spare means no alert, whatever else is set. reserve must be the string none, qty, or ticks. none requires spare above 0. qty requires spare minus reserve_amount to be above 0. ticks requires the Ticks-Worth the game prints to be above reserve_amount - that number already has Used taken off it, so it is compared as it stands rather than being charged for Used twice. reserve_amount must be a non-negative whole number. N/A ticks count as never running out and NONE as less than one tick, but neither can alert without a spare above 0.
market._overrides_help: friends alerts on buyers on your friends list (blue in game); alliance alerts on buyers in your alliance (green in game); a buyer who is both satisfies either. always and never override both. IMPORTANT: they match the NATION name exactly as it appears in the Buyer column of the marketplace, NOT the player's username - the two are unrelated in this game, so a player called Lacera Viscera may play a nation called Fish Bucket, and you must write the nation. Matching works like reports.ignore: case-insensitive, anywhere in the name, % standing for any run of characters. never beats always, and always beats both friends and alliance. An always or never entry starting with # is switched off too. Note friends and alliance cover every nation a player owns, while always and never name one nation each.

fourchan._thread_url_help: Set thread_url to a thread you want watched, for example https://boards.4chan.org/mlp/thread/43454282/clop-financial-crisis-edition. Leave it null to disable thread monitoring; threads archive, so a URL left here goes stale.
